admission.justification: Without the pointer, an operator whose client stopped waiting on a closeout or sync has no documented place to learn how the call ended and may repeat a publication that already happened.

applicability: The tool-log section of the concepts guide and the sync and closeout sections of the tool reference.
conditions: A client stops waiting before a closeout or sync call ends.
exclusions: The time limit of the sync's Git commands.
statement: The tool-log and operator documentation describe how to find closeout or sync outcomes after a client stops waiting.
